metadata.title: Complete Family Tree of Fredric Muller Vollmer
metadata.scope: Recovered maternal direct tree plus all later paternal direct and three-ring collateral research, including the documented Thoren-Gallaher parents of Mary Alice Thoren.
metadata.privacy: Living dates, addresses, contact information, and speculative modern links are omitted.
